analysis_scope: post-development descriptive aggregation of the original saved receipts

definitions.anchors: fixed training-partition inputs at steps 0,80,160,240; repeated measurements within roots
definitions.causal: fixed warmup projector at every arm's current model state
definitions.causal_live: current V-column projector using the frozen selected indices
definitions.causal_sham: root-seeded signed permutation of the fixed-projector edit
definitions.cosine: cosine between realized fixed and live edits, averaged over each root's cases
definitions.group_overlap: equal selected index sets; candidate groups are disjoint contiguous sets of four
definitions.hybrid_state_oracle: full hybrid-state replacement; privileged input and unmatched natural dose
definitions.rates: pooled counts; roots have equal case counts, while conditional corruption denominators differ
definitions.resources: root elapsed and CPU times are incremental; Linux ru_maxrss is process lifetime high-water KiB

independent_unit: independently initialized model root with four paired training arms

resources.rss_aggregation: maximum process lifetime high-water mark; peaks are not added across sequential roots
